claims.text: The FDA cobicistat label says coadministration with colchicine is contraindicated in patients with renal or hepatic impairment because of potential serious or life-threatening reactions.
claims.quote: Coadministration with colchicine is contraindicated in patients with renal and/or hepatic impairment due to potential for serious and/or life-threatening reactions.

claims.text: The Spanish cobicistat label says colchicine plasma concentrations may increase when given with cobicistat and colchicine doses may need to be reduced.
claims.quote: Las concentraciones plasmáticas de colchicina pueden aumentar al administrarse de forma concomitante con cobicistat. Puede ser necesario reducir las dosis de colchicina.
claims.quoteEnglish: Colchicine plasma concentrations may increase when administered concomitantly with cobicistat. It may be necessary to reduce colchicine doses.

headline.text: The FDA label contraindicates colchicine with cobicistat in patients with renal or hepatic impairment (c1).

reported.text: The Spanish label says colchicine concentrations may rise with cobicistat and doses may need reducing (c2).

gaps.text: No controlled human study of this combination was found in the PubMed search.
